"''I'm just getting started.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Kawlan Roken|{{Kenobi|Part VI}}}} '''Kawlan Roken''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] activist during the [[Imperial Era|height]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], who operated an underground network known as [[Hidden Path]] that smuggled surviving [[Jedi]] and [[Force-sensitive]]s to safety during the [[Great Jedi Purge]]. He was once [[Marriage|married]] to a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Kawlan Roken's wife|woman]], who was hunted down by the mysterious, Force-sensitive [[Dark side adept|agents]] of the [[Inquisitorius]]. ==Biography== Kawlan Roken once [[Marriage|married]] a [[Kawlan Roken's wife|woman]] who turned out to be [[Force-sensitive]]. The couple tried hard to hide her [[The Force|Force]]-sensitivity, but she was hunted down by the [[Inquisitorius]], an organization of the [[Galactic Empire]] dedicated to [[hunting]] down Force-sensitives. After her disappearance, Roken helped operate and lead [[Hidden Path|The Path]], an underground network which smuggled [[Jedi]] and Force-sensitives from the Empire. When he learned that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] survived the [[Great Jedi Purge]] and needed his help to [[Rescue of Princess Leia (9 BBY)|rescue]] [[Alderaanian]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], he was reluctant to offer it. Eventually, he helped Kenobi and [[Tala Durith]] infiltrate [[Fortress Inquisitorius]], and the Alderaanian princess was rescued. [[File:MembersOfThePath-OWK.png|thumb|300px|left|Roken led the underground movement known as The Path.]] Once they arrived at the [[planet]] [[Jabiim]], Roken led an evacuation effort in order to allow the [[refugee]]s being hidden to escape, with the usage of a soon-to-be-closed [[Hyperspace route|trade route]]. Unknown to any of the members of the rescue team, Leia's [[toy droid]] companion [[L0-LA59]] was outfitted with a tracker which traced the rescue team's location to Jabiim, leading to a [[Attack on Jabiim|siege]] of the planet led by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]]. Initially unaware, Roken was caught off guard when the base [[hangar]]'s blast doors were sealed shut, until he was made aware of an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in [[orbit]] of the planet. Working with the former [[Jedi General]], Roken, along with many other denizens of the underground operation, helped direct the task of sealing all the other blast doors, and helped handle the unlocking of the hangar's main doors. At Organa's insistence and at Kenobi's urging, Roken helped the princess climb into the vents to help with the hangar's doors.{{Kenobi|Part V}} Roken later helped guard the main blast door to the base, wielding a [[bowcaster]] and blasting multiple [[stormtrooper]]s. He expressed disbelief at Kenobi's defeated attitude, and watched as he surrendered himself to the Imperials waiting outside. Kawlan later evacuated with the refugees and Kenobi on board a [[Kawlan Roken's second freight transport|transport]]; being made aware of the [[transport]]'s [[hyperdrive]] being nonoperational and expressing worry, he mentioned it to Kenobi. When Kenobi realized he could leave from the freighter to distract Vader, Roken objected but ultimately relented. Parting ways with the rebel leader, Kenobi advised him not to stop his stand against the Empire, which Roken promised he would not stop any time soon. ==Personality and traits== [[File:KawlanRoken-Heroes2023.png|thumb|right|200px|Roken was committed to fighting the Empire.]] Kawlan Roken was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with dark skin and dark hair that included a beard. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Roken is leading what we hope will eventually become what we know as the Rebellion. This is kind of like the first chapter. He's just a regular guy just trying to do the right thing and it leads him down this path to be something bigger than what he is.|O'Shea Jackson Jr|''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]''}} Kawlan Roken first appeared in "[[Part IV]]" of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', which premiered on [[Disney+]]. He was portrayed by actor [[O'Shea Jackson Jr.]] His full name was revealed in the ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' series official [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] account on [[June 13]], [[2022]], along with the character's official poster.{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1536362804088696832|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|date=2022-06-13|quote="If you want my help, you got it."|archivedate=20220613150124}} ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part IV}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 4|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 4]] *{{Kenobi|Part V}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 5|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 5]] *{{Kenobi|Part VI}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 6|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 6]] *[[Star Wars (2020) 43|''Star Wars'' (2020) 43]] {{C|Variant cover only}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/obi-wan-wednesdays-week-4|text=Obi-Wan Wednesdays: The Purge Trooper Joins Hasbro's Black Series and More!}} *{{SW|url=news/obi-wan-wednesdays-week-5|text=Obi-Wan Wednesdays: Funko's ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Pop! 5-Pack Revealed and More!}} {{Po}} *{{SWYouTube|sYN9mXiskBc|Looking Back on the Series | Obi-Wan Kenobi | Disney+|sw_url=video/looking-back-on-the-series-obi-wan-kenobi}} *{{SWYouTube|ufI9DDBJVGs|Behind the Scenes of the Obi-Wan Kenobi Series!|sw_url=video/behind-the-scenes-of-the-obi-wan-kenobi-series}} *''[[Obi-Wan Kenobi: A Jedi's Return]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|76|Starships and Vehicles}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Topps|set=2025 Topps Chrome Star Wars|cardname=#70 - Kawlan Roken|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/257103755947}} *{{Databank|kawlan-roken|Kawlan Roken}} *{{Databank|the-hidden-path|the Hidden Path}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Kawlan Roken |es=Kawlan Roken |fr=Kawlan Roken |ja=カウラン・ローケン |ka=კოლან როკენი |nl=Kawlan Roken |pl=Kawlan Roken }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Roken, Kawlan}} [[Category:Hidden Path members]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Smugglers]]
